scope: Pre-run code/formula/integrity review plus synthetic tests and existing 13 archived trials; no claim about future stage2 outcomes.

resolved_findings.finding: First oracle revision accepted unbound road progress and unverified partial/altered public graph.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current oracle requires same-tick native road_state and odometry; complete map_graph edge dictionary from preceding native query; native road geometry for each public edge; public length agrees with true polyline at 8 world units/metre within existing 0.1cm rounding.

resolved_findings.finding: Inherited demo gates compared events and exported-manifest summaries without proving all native PNG/query/sample arrays.
resolved_findings.resolution: New independent audit_native_evidence checks complete record file hash/bytes/inventory, actual source vs loaded frozen program, all queries, exact samples, every native frame metadata and base64 PNG, every same-tick/revision renderTruth and all logged red/blue raw detections.

resolved_findings.finding: Legacy angle was computed before approach/recovery; first new formula also used left-positive public heading against right-positive WM sight.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current actual_grab_sight_angle uses exact native same-tick startState pose and degrees(initialHeading-grabHeading); old pre-approach angle retained separately. Missing/inconsistent exact pose remains unknown.

resolved_findings.finding: Replacement two-ball gate initially omitted source_verified when relaxing depart/600s restrictions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Current complete_two_ball_attribution retains distinct track IDs, slots1/2, allowed memory/new_observations sources and verified source evidence, without demanding successful post-delivery departure.

review_conclusions.truth_association: At actual first ball-1 target_selection snapshot, chosen WM position must have exactly one target package within30cm; nearest alone is insufficient; unmatched/ambiguous choices cannot match.
review_conclusions.oracle_distance: Floyd-Warshall independent from runtime Dijkstra, nearest truth-road projection ties and legal current/target partial endpoints, same-road direct options, oneWay handling. Initial shortest turn only; no Euclidean substitute for route distance.
review_conclusions.denominators: Exactly two real target candidates are enumerated. Round first-choice rate uses all10 layouts; absent/unmatched/unknown selections are not matches. Independent two-ball trajectory grouping is also reported and includes both ball slots.
review_conclusions.two_ball_events: Physical success requires two distinct true packages each associated to confirmed WM and matching native accepted grab plus verified non-revoked delivery. Successful final delivery survives later departure failure.
review_conclusions.fixed_rules: Actual WM hit increments/distinct-position ranges and same selected track, confirmation/window/gaps/lastsample, memory>=30cm, approach<=25cm/maxsteps1/perballcalls<=3 remain assessed; native global error/observe/onRoad/image disciplines retained.
review_conclusions.native_binding: 13 archived trials allpass;272 native PNGs;63689599 decoded/native bytes. No native flags are trusted in place of byte and inventory comparisons.
scope_limits: No new simulation; no new outcome or latency claim.
P3 k is accepted from the separately frozen measured calibration and remains bounded by that calibration protocol validity.
WM generalization precision is reported only for E/G; other positions are descriptive.
Class-only holding does not prove package identity; independent actual native package events and true confirmation association supply the physical evidence.
This review records source hashes at review time; later frozen manifest is authoritative for executed round.
